story_type: rocket fuel tank loaded until it buckles and rips open, test to failure
hook: They squeezed a Moon rocket tank until it ripped open.
narration: Engineers squeezed this rocket fuel tank until it ripped open.
It was a test tank for NASA's Moon rocket, loaded with nitrogen gas pressure and hydraulic force at Marshall Space Flight Center in Alabama.
It had already survived the forces of a Moon launch. [short pause] This time they kept going.
Pieces of the tank wall flew out past the camera.
outcome: The tank held more than 260 percent of its expected flight loads before it buckled and ruptured, as engineers predicted.
title: Moon rocket tank pushed until it ripped
question_comment: Would you have guessed it could take more than twice a real flight's load?
